name: Xunzi (Xun Kuang)
shortBio: Major classical Confucian philosopher who argued against Mencius that innate human nature is unruly and selfish (xing e), requiring deliberate cultural transformation through ritual (li) and education.
centralQuestion: How can inherently chaotic and selfish human nature be artificially transformed into moral harmony and social order through ritual and discipline?

keyWorks.title: Xunzi
keyWorks.description: Systematic collection of philosophical essays articulating realistic Confucianism, the artificiality of goodness (wei), ritual logic, and the rectification of names.
